summary: The candidate fixes the timing-dependent double charge among ranks in one multi-rank TP group by taking a TP CPU-group MIN snapshot before allocation. Its focused tests and real three-process Gloo regression pass. It does not make the host-wide decision independent of ordering when more than one TP group is co-located: ranks_per_host divides by every local rank, but the snapshot synchronizes only one TP group. A real four-process/two-group Gloo case retains the false rejection even though all requested pools fit at the initial reading. This is a partial fix, not test-only hardening, but it does not fully satisfy the issue's host-wide contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Deterministically reproduced the base formula's timing-dependent false rejection: with 100 GiB initially available, a 10 GiB reserve, four ranks, and 20 GiB per rank, later readings yield budgets below 20 GiB although all pools fit initially. It also identified the two-TP-group counterexample.
At exact candidate commit, all seven candidate host-budget unit tests passed, including mocked MIN/group/dtype behavior and boundary fallbacks.
At exact candidate commit, a real three-process Gloo collective in one group reduced divergent readings to the same minimum-derived budget on every rank.

Independent real four-process Gloo counterexample using two two-rank TP-like groups. Group A obtained 22.5 GiB/rank and later group B obtained 12.5 GiB/rank; a 20 GiB request therefore still fails in group B although four such pools fit in the initial 100 GiB with the 10 GiB reserve.
The exact candidate Python source compiled successfully and imported from /job/repo/python, not from an installed wheel.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned device is one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950). The reported workload requires 8xH200 (SM90), TP8, GLM-5.2-W4AFP8 weights, and roughly 1.7 TiB host RAM. No GPU/model-serving claim was made; CPU/Gloo processes directly exercised the changed synchronization path.

remaining_counterexamples: Two or more TP groups co-located on one host remain timing-dependent because ranks_per_host counts all local ranks while host_memory_sync_group synchronizes only the current TP group. If one group allocates before another samples, the later group double-counts the earlier allocation and can reject pools that fit host-wide.
The same topology gap can occur with multiple pipeline stages or in-job data-parallel TP groups on one host; candidate tests cover only a single synchronization group.
remaining_limitations: The exact 8xH200 GLM-5.2-W4AFP8 startup and sidecar allocation sequence could not be run on the assigned single gfx950 GPU, and model weights were unavailable.
The independent counterexample uses real Gloo collectives and controlled psutil readings rather than allocating tens or hundreds of GiB of pinned host memory.
No native files changed between base and candidate, repository-environment.json declares native null, and therefore no native rebuild was applicable.
